description: This file declares data structures and function prototypes for managing a notes cache in a version control system. It includes definitions for the notes cache structure, initialization, read/write operations, retrieval, and insertion of note data associated with object identifiers.

methods.name: notes_cache_init
methods.description: Initializes a notes cache associated with a repository, setting up necessary data structures and parameters.

methods.name: notes_cache_write
methods.description: Writes the current state of the notes cache to persistent storage.

methods.name: notes_cache_get
methods.description: Retrieves notes associated with a specific object ID, returning the data and its size.

methods.name: notes_cache_put
methods.description: Associates note data with a specific object ID in the cache.
